title: death chest
description: Spawns a chest containing all of the player's items upon death.
body:
# ⚰️ DeathChest

**A lightweight, server-side death chest mod for Minecraft 26.2 (Fabric).**  
When you die, all your items are saved in a chest at your death location — ready to pick up with a single left-click.

---

## ✨ Features

- 📦 **Automatic chest spawning** on death — single or double chest depending on item count
- 👆 **Left-click to retrieve** all items instantly back into their original slots
- 🎯 **Smart slot restoration** — items return to the exact slots they were in before death
- 🌊 **Replaces liquids** — spawns in water or lava without issue
- 🧱 **Guaranteed spawn** — 3-phase search algorithm ensures a chest always appears:
  - Phase 1: Same column ±50 blocks up/down
  - Phase 2: 100×100 area ±20 Y around death point
  - Phase 3: Obsidian platform fallback — **always spawns**
- 🌀 **Void death support** — configurable behavior when dying below world height
- 💥 **Explosion monitoring** — detects externally destroyed chests and cleans up state
- 🏷️ **Named chests** — `Lars's death chest` shown in chest UI and as floating text display
- 📋 **Detailed log file** — all events saved to `logs/deathchest.log`
- ⚙️ **Admin commands** — configure on the fly without restart
- 🌍 **Multilingual** — English, German, French, Simplified Chinese

---

## 🖱️ How it works

1. You die → chest spawns at death location with all your items
2. A floating text label shows the chest owner and instructions
3. **Left-click** the chest → items return to your inventory in original slots
4. If inventory is full, remaining items stay in the chest
5. Chest disappears after left-clicking (no free chest exploit!)
6. **Right-click** still opens the chest normally

---

## ⌨️ Admin Commands

Requires OP level 2.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/deathchest info` | Show active chest count and current settings |
| `/deathchest list` | List all active death chests with owner and position |
| `/deathchest voidmode NEAREST_BLOCK` | Spawn chest on nearest solid block when dying in void |
| `/deathchest voidmode DISABLED` | No chest, no message when dying in void |

---

## 📁 Config file

Auto-generated at `config/deathchest.json` on first launch:

```json
{
  "voidMode": "NEAREST_BLOCK",
  "_optionen": "NEAREST_BLOCK | DISABLED"
}
```

---

## 📋 Log file

Every death and chest event is logged to `logs/deathchest.log`:

```
[2026-06-29 21:05:42] DEATH       | Spieler: Lars | Pos: 100, 64, -200 | Cause: fall
[2026-06-29 21:05:42] CHEST_SPAWN | Spieler: Lars | Typ: EINZEL | Pos: 100, 65, -200 | Items: 34
[2026-06-29 21:06:10] RETRIEVE    | Spieler: Lars | Zurück: 34 | In Truhe: 0
[2026-06-29 21:07:00] VOID_DEATH  | Spieler: Lars | VoidMode: NEAREST_BLOCK
```

---

## 🌍 Translations

| Language | Status |
|---|---|
| English (`en_us`) | ✅ Complete |
| German (`de_de`) | ✅ Complete |
| French (`fr_fr`) | ✅ Complete |
| Simplified Chinese (`zh_cn`) | ✅ Complete |

Want to add your language? Open a PR on the GitHub repository!

---

## ⚙️ Requirements

- Minecraft **26.2**
- Fabric Loader **≥ 0.19.3**
- Fabric API
- Java **25**
- **Server-side only** — clients do not need the mod installed

---

## 🐛 Known Issues / Notes

- The "Mismatch in destroy block pos" warning in server logs is a harmless Vanilla behaviour with double chests and can be safely ignored.
